name: CitedSEO
author: AdWorks Bid

sections.description:
The first WordPress SEO plugin built for AI-era search. While other plugins optimize only for Google’s traditional results, CitedSEO also prepares your content for where search is going: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Everything below is free — no locked features, no trial limits.

On-Page SEO
Analyze any post or page against its focus keyword. Scores title, meta description, content length, keyword usage, headings, images, and internal links. Scores appear as a colored circle directly in the Posts and Pages list tables (similar to Rank Math’s column) so you can triage your entire site at a glance.

XML Sitemaps
Auto-generated sitemaps for posts, pages, taxonomies, images, and Google News. Served virtually — no static file needed. Submit to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools from the Sitemap admin page. Flush cache on demand.

Google Search Console Integration
Connect GSC via OAuth and pull clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position directly into your WordPress dashboard. Date-range selector (7/28/90/180 days and custom). Top pages and top queries tables with period-over-period change.

Google Analytics 4 Integration
Connect GA4 via the same OAuth flow. Traffic data feeds the CitedSEO dashboard alongside GSC data.

Rank Tracker
Track unlimited keywords and their Google Search Console positions. Historical position chart per keyword. Daily automatic position refresh via WP-Cron.

Local SEO
Add and manage business locations with full address, phone, email, geo-coordinates, business hours, and price range. Automatically generates LocalBusiness schema markup.

Hreflang Manager
Define language/region pairs and let CitedSEO inject the correct hreflang link elements in <head> across your site.

Arabic SEO & RTL Support
Built for Arabic and GCC markets, not just translated. The on-page analyzer is Arabic-aware — Unicode-safe word counting plus morphological keyword matching that recognizes inflected and root forms of an Arabic keyword, not just exact-phrase matches. Switch the entire admin interface to Arabic with a native right-to-left layout, in the same Cairo typeface used throughout the plugin (including PRO client reports). The built-in Dialect Keyword Adapter generates keyword variants across 9 Arabic dialects — Modern Standard Arabic, Saudi, Egyptian, Kuwaiti, Lebanese, Emirati, Iraqi, Jordanian, and Moroccan — so you can target how people in each market actually search.
The admin interface can also switch itself automatically: CitedSEO detects WPML, Polylang, or your site’s default WordPress language, and flips to Arabic on its own the moment your site is Arabic — no settings hunt required. Turn this off in Settings if you’d rather set it manually.

Redirects
Create, edit, and delete 301/302 redirects from the admin. Tracks hit counts per redirect.

Broken Link Checker
Scans all internal and external links in your content. Displays HTTP status codes and last-checked timestamps. Manual scan on demand, with opt-in automatic daily background scan via WP-Cron.

Bulk Editor
Edit title tags and meta descriptions for hundreds of posts in a spreadsheet-style table. Export to CSV.

Content Decay
Flag posts whose organic traffic has been declining. Prioritize which content to refresh first.

Keyword Cannibalization Scanner
Detect when multiple pages are competing for the same focus keyword and risking self-competition in Google.

Schema Markup
Add Article, FAQ, Product, Recipe, Event, Local Business, Breadcrumb, and more — with a clean admin UI. Output as JSON-LD in <head>.

Instant Indexing
Submit URLs directly to Google’s Indexing API and Bing Webmaster Tools for faster crawling after publish or update.

WooCommerce SEO
Optimized title and meta templates for product pages. Bulk-fix missing product image alt text.

Dashboard
KPI strip showing clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position from GSC and Bing. Traffic chart with range selector. SEO snapshot widget on the native WordPress Dashboard screen.

Built for AI-Era Search
AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews now surface content before users ever click a search result. CitedSEO builds the foundations these engines rely on: structured schema markup, well-defined entities, clean on-page signals, and fast-loading pages. Every feature in this plugin contributes to how confidently an AI engine can read, understand, and cite your content.

For full AI Search Optimization including GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AI prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Claude, and llms.txt generation, upgrade to CitedSEO PRO.

Extend with CitedSEO PRO
CitedSEO PRO is a separate, optional add-on available at adworks.bid/awbseo-pro. Pro features include:

  • GEO / AI SEO — Optimize content for Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine Optimization. Auto-generates llms.txt and structured AI-friendly content signals.
  • AI Search Optimizer — Track how your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Claude across your target prompts.
  • Brand Visibility on AI Engines — Monitor and grow brand citations in AI-generated answers.
  • AI Content Writer — Generate SEO-optimized drafts using your own AI API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity).
  • AI Link Architecture — Smart internal linking powered by semantic analysis.
  • Local Rank Grid — Visualize keyword rankings across a geographic grid map.
  • Core Web Vitals Monitor — Track LCP, INP, and CLS via PageSpeed Insights API.
  • Revenue Intelligence — Connect revenue data to SEO performance.
  • White-label Client Reports — Branded PDF reports with your logo and client data.
  • Activity Log & ClickUp Sync — Automatically logs every completed SEO task and syncs it to ClickUp, so agencies can track work and build client reports without duplicate data entry.

The free plugin works fully without Pro.

External Services

CitedSEO connects to the following third-party services, only when you enable the related feature. No data is sent without you taking that action.

Google Search Console — Pulls clicks, impressions, CTR, and position data into your dashboard via searchconsole.googleapis.com. Activated when you connect GSC via OAuth in Settings. Privacy Policy · Terms

Google Analytics 4 — Displays GA4 traffic data in your dashboard via analyticsdata.googleapis.com. Activated when you connect GA4 via OAuth in Settings. Privacy Policy · Terms

Bing Webmaster Tools — Pulls Bing search performance data and submits sitemaps via ssl.bing.com/webmaster. Activated when you connect Bing in Settings. Privacy Statement · Services Agreement

IndexNow — Notifies Bing, Yandex, and Cloudflare via api.indexnow.org when a URL is published or updated. Activated only if Instant Indexing auto-submit is turned on in Settings. Privacy Policy · Terms

AdWorks.Bid OAuth Broker — Exchanges Google OAuth authorization codes for access tokens via oauth.adworksbid.com so your client secret never touches the browser. Activated when you connect GSC or GA4; only your site URL, a temporary code, and a nonce are sent — no post content or user data. Privacy Policy · Terms

Google Fonts (Cairo) — Loads a typeface for the admin interface via fonts.googleapis.com on every CitedSEO admin page. Privacy Policy · Fonts FAQ

دعم اللغة العربية (Arabic Language Support)

سيتد إس إي أو (CitedSEO) هو إضافة ووردبريس مجانية لتحسين محركات البحث، مصممة لعصر البحث بالذكاء الاصطناعي. توفر الإضافة تحليلاً للصفحات، بيانات منظمة (Schema)، خرائط مواقع XML، تتبع ترتيب الكلمات المفتاحية، وتكاملاً مع Google Search Console وGoogle Analytics 4 — كل ذلك مجانًا بالكامل. تدعم الإضافة اللغة العربية بشكل كامل: واجهة إدارة بتصميم من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL)، تحليل محتوى يراعي خصائص اللغة العربية، وأداة لتوليد كلمات مفتاحية بلهجات عربية مختلفة (خليجية، مصرية، لبنانية، وغيرها). الإضافة مثالية لمواقع الشرق الأوسط ودول الخليج العربي التي تستهدف الظهور في نتائج البحث التقليدية ومحركات الذكاء الاصطناعي على حد سواء.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the adworksbid-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to CitedSEO → Dashboard to start setup.
  4. Connect Google Search Console via Settings → GSC to unlock traffic data.
sections.faq:
Is everything really free?

Yes. All features listed in the description are fully functional with no usage limits. CitedSEO PRO is a separate add-on, not a trial or upgrade gate on the free features.

Does this plugin track my users?

No. CitedSEO does not collect or transmit user data. The Google Search Console and GA4 integrations use OAuth tokens stored only in your own WordPress database and communicate directly between your site and Google’s servers.

Is it compatible with Gutenberg?

Yes. The meta box and all admin pages work in both the classic editor and the block editor.

Can I use this with WooCommerce?

Yes. The WooCommerce SEO module generates optimized title and meta templates for product archive pages and individual product pages.

Does it conflict with Yoast, Rank Math, or SEOPress?

Running two SEO plugins simultaneously can cause duplicate meta tags. We recommend deactivating other SEO plugins when using CitedSEO.

How is CitedSEO different from Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

CitedSEO includes everything those plugins offer — on-page analysis, schema, sitemaps, redirects — plus features they don’t have: a built-in rank tracker, content decay detection, keyword cannibalization scanner, AI search visibility foundations, and local SEO, all free with no feature gates. CitedSEO PRO adds AI prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Claude, plus GEO and AEO content optimization and white-label client reports.

Does CitedSEO help with AI search visibility (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini)?

Yes. CitedSEO builds the technical foundations AI engines rely on to read, understand, and cite your content: structured schema markup, clean on-page signals, entity optimization, and fast-loading pages. CitedSEO PRO adds full AI prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Claude, plus GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) content transformation.

What is GEO and AEO?

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) are the practices of structuring and writing content so AI engines can extract, cite, and recommend it in their answers. This goes beyond traditional SEO — it means direct-answer paragraphs, clear entity definitions, scannable Q&A structure, and content that AI engines can quote accurately. CitedSEO PRO handles this for WordPress sites.
sections.changelog:
1.3.60

  • New: Rank Tracker now does a real live position check instead of only relying on Search Console. When GSC is disconnected, or simply has no data yet for a keyword (the normal case for a brand-new page or a lower-volume market), it falls back to a live Google SERP check via an optional self-service SerpApi.com key under Settings > Rank Tracker. Each tracked keyword can also be pinned to one of the plugin’s 9 Arabic dialect regions, so “how do I rank for this in Kuwait” and “how do I rank for it in Saudi” are tracked as separate rows for the same term, with both the GSC country filter and the live SERP check scoped to that market.
  • Fix: content-length and heading-question checks used an ASCII-only word counter and Latin-only “?” detection, which could undercount legitimately long Arabic articles and miss Arabic-language question headings (؟) entirely on PRO’s AI Answer Simulator and Question Gap Detector modules. Both now use Unicode-aware counting and recognize the Arabic question mark, and the Question Gap Detector now generates Arabic (MSA) question suggestions instead of English ones when the post’s own content is Arabic.

1.3.59

  • New: when Polylang or WPML is active and the post being edited is set to Arabic, the CitedSEO meta box now shows its own labels, tab names, hints, buttons, and placeholders in Arabic (SEO Title, Meta Description, SERP Preview, Social/Advanced/Schema/Analysis tabs, the Content origin flag, the Arabizi field, and the dialect adapter) – independent of the plugin’s own admin-interface language setting, so an English-language admin editing an Arabic post (the common agency setup) still gets Arabic chrome. This never touches the post’s own title/description content, which is always exactly what was typed or auto-generated. The dynamic on-page-analysis check messages in the Analysis tab and the robots meta values (index/noindex/follow/nofollow) are left in English on purpose – the former is a separate, larger PHP-side job, the latter are technical directive values recognized as-is.

1.3.58

  • Fix: SERP Preview and the Canonical URL field in the meta box showed a percent-encoded gibberish string (e.g. %d8%a7%d9%84…) for Arabic post slugs instead of readable Arabic. This is a separate code path from the earlier on-page-analysis slug-suggestion fix (1.3.x) – that one covered the suggested slug, this covers the live post’s actual permalink as shown in the meta box – and is now decoded the same way.
  • Fix: Arabic text typed into the meta box (SEO title, meta description, SERP preview) now renders in the same Cairo typeface used everywhere else in CitedSEO and in the PRO white-label client reports. The earlier Cairo fix only applied when the admin interface language itself was set to Arabic; it now also applies on the post editor screen even when the interface language is English, which is the common case when editing Arabic client content from an English-language admin.

1.3.57

  • New: Author / E-E-A-T profile fields on each user’s WordPress profile (credentials or job title, an Arabic display name, areas of expertise, and professional profile links) – Article and Blog Post schema now emits a real Person block built from these instead of just a bare name, with the Arabic name shown as primary on Arabic posts and as an alternate on non-Arabic ones. Also fixes the publisher logo in that same schema, which previously always emitted an empty URL.
  • New: optional “content origin” flag in the meta box – mark a post as natively written, translated, or mixed, with an inline reminder to give translated content a native-language editing pass.

1.3.56

  • New: optional Arabizi/code-switch keyword field next to the focus keyword in the meta box – captures a Latin-letter transliterated or mixed-language variant, which is then treated as an alternative match everywhere the focus keyword is checked (title, description, URL slug, density, intro paragraph, subheadings) and included alongside the main keyword in this page’s schema markup.
  • New: Query language breakdown on the Analytics page splits Search Console queries into Arabic vs everything else, each with its own clicks/impressions/CTR/position totals and top-query list, instead of one blended ranking that buries whichever language has less volume.
  • New: schema markup for Articles, Blog Posts, Pages, Products, How-Tos, and Recipes now carries inLanguage (the page’s actual detected language, not just the site default) and a stable per-page @id, so multilingual and Arabic-on-English-site content is identified correctly to Google and AI answer engines.
  • New: dialect-aware local SEO content – generate a Google Business Profile description or a review reply in any of the nine supported Arabic dialects, in Local SEO settings.

1.3.55

  • New: hreflang settings now include a one-click Arabic dialect region picker (the same nine dialects as the meta box, mapped to real codes like ar-SA, ar-AE, ar-EG) so you insert valid hreflang codes instead of typing them by hand.
  • New: “Validate Hreflang Pairs” button checks your saved hreflang pairs against the live pages – confirms each URL returns 200 and that pairs actually link back to each other (Google ignores hreflang that isn’t reciprocal), and flags pages missing a self-referencing tag.

1.3.54

  • Fix: the URL-slug suggestion in on-page analysis showed a percent-encoded gibberish string (e.g. %d8%b9%d9%84…) for Arabic focus keywords instead of readable Arabic. It now decodes back to the actual Arabic slug. The underlying pass/fail check for whether the keyword is already in the slug was already correct and is unchanged.

1.3.53

  • New: on-page analysis now recognizes Arabic letter-form variants (alef, taa marbuta, alef maqsura) and diacritics as equivalent, and uses a light Arabic stemmer for keyword density and match checks instead of blunt substring matching. A focus keyword written one valid way now correctly matches content spelled another valid way.

1.3.52

1.3.50

short_description: SEO plugin for AI-era search with real Arabic dialect support: on-page analysis, schema, rank tracking, GSC & GA4, all free. PRO adds AI visibility.
description:
The first WordPress SEO plugin built for AI-era search. While other plugins optimize only for Google’s traditional results, CitedSEO also prepares your content for where search is going: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Everything below is free — no locked features, no trial limits.

On-Page SEO
Analyze any post or page against its focus keyword. Scores title, meta description, content length, keyword usage, headings, images, and internal links. Scores appear as a colored circle directly in the Posts and Pages list tables (similar to Rank Math’s column) so you can triage your entire site at a glance.

XML Sitemaps
Auto-generated sitemaps for posts, pages, taxonomies, images, and Google News. Served virtually — no static file needed. Submit to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools from the Sitemap admin page. Flush cache on demand.

Google Search Console Integration
Connect GSC via OAuth and pull clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position directly into your WordPress dashboard. Date-range selector (7/28/90/180 days and custom). Top pages and top queries tables with period-over-period change.

Google Analytics 4 Integration
Connect GA4 via the same OAuth flow. Traffic data feeds the CitedSEO dashboard alongside GSC data.

Rank Tracker
Track unlimited keywords and their Google Search Console positions. Historical position chart per keyword. Daily automatic position refresh via WP-Cron.

Local SEO
Add and manage business locations with full address, phone, email, geo-coordinates, business hours, and price range. Automatically generates LocalBusiness schema markup.

Hreflang Manager
Define language/region pairs and let CitedSEO inject the correct hreflang link elements in <head> across your site.

Arabic SEO & RTL Support
Built for Arabic and GCC markets, not just translated. The on-page analyzer is Arabic-aware — Unicode-safe word counting plus morphological keyword matching that recognizes inflected and root forms of an Arabic keyword, not just exact-phrase matches. Switch the entire admin interface to Arabic with a native right-to-left layout, in the same Cairo typeface used throughout the plugin (including PRO client reports). The built-in Dialect Keyword Adapter generates keyword variants across 9 Arabic dialects — Modern Standard Arabic, Saudi, Egyptian, Kuwaiti, Lebanese, Emirati, Iraqi, Jordanian, and Moroccan — so you can target how people in each market actually search.
The admin interface can also switch itself automatically: CitedSEO detects WPML, Polylang, or your site’s default WordPress language, and flips to Arabic on its own the moment your site is Arabic — no settings hunt required. Turn this off in Settings if you’d rather set it manually.

Redirects
Create, edit, and delete 301/302 redirects from the admin. Tracks hit counts per redirect.

Broken Link Checker
Scans all internal and external links in your content. Displays HTTP status codes and last-checked timestamps. Manual scan on demand, with opt-in automatic daily background scan via WP-Cron.

Bulk Editor
Edit title tags and meta descriptions for hundreds of posts in a spreadsheet-style table. Export to CSV.

Content Decay
Flag posts whose organic traffic has been declining. Prioritize which content to refresh first.

Keyword Cannibalization Scanner
Detect when multiple pages are competing for the same focus keyword and risking self-competition in Google.

Schema Markup
Add Article, FAQ, Product, Recipe, Event, Local Business, Breadcrumb, and more — with a clean admin UI. Output as JSON-LD in <head>.

Instant Indexing
Submit URLs directly to Google’s Indexing API and Bing Webmaster Tools for faster crawling after publish or update.

WooCommerce SEO
Optimized title and meta templates for product pages. Bulk-fix missing product image alt text.

Dashboard
KPI strip showing clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position from GSC and Bing. Traffic chart with range selector. SEO snapshot widget on the native WordPress Dashboard screen.

Built for AI-Era Search
AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews now surface content before users ever click a search result. CitedSEO builds the foundations these engines rely on: structured schema markup, well-defined entities, clean on-page signals, and fast-loading pages. Every feature in this plugin contributes to how confidently an AI engine can read, understand, and cite your content.

For full AI Search Optimization including GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), AI prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Claude, and llms.txt generation, upgrade to CitedSEO PRO.

Extend with CitedSEO PRO
CitedSEO PRO is a separate, optional add-on available at adworks.bid/awbseo-pro. Pro features include:

  • GEO / AI SEO — Optimize content for Generative Engine Optimization and Answer Engine Optimization. Auto-generates llms.txt and structured AI-friendly content signals.
  • AI Search Optimizer — Track how your brand appears in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Claude across your target prompts.
  • Brand Visibility on AI Engines — Monitor and grow brand citations in AI-generated answers.
  • AI Content Writer — Generate SEO-optimized drafts using your own AI API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity).
  • AI Link Architecture — Smart internal linking powered by semantic analysis.
  • Local Rank Grid — Visualize keyword rankings across a geographic grid map.
  • Core Web Vitals Monitor — Track LCP, INP, and CLS via PageSpeed Insights API.
  • Revenue Intelligence — Connect revenue data to SEO performance.
  • White-label Client Reports — Branded PDF reports with your logo and client data.
  • Activity Log & ClickUp Sync — Automatically logs every completed SEO task and syncs it to ClickUp, so agencies can track work and build client reports without duplicate data entry.

The free plugin works fully without Pro.

External Services

CitedSEO connects to the following third-party services, only when you enable the related feature. No data is sent without you taking that action.

Google Search Console — Pulls clicks, impressions, CTR, and position data into your dashboard via searchconsole.googleapis.com. Activated when you connect GSC via OAuth in Settings. Privacy Policy · Terms

Google Analytics 4 — Displays GA4 traffic data in your dashboard via analyticsdata.googleapis.com. Activated when you connect GA4 via OAuth in Settings. Privacy Policy · Terms

Bing Webmaster Tools — Pulls Bing search performance data and submits sitemaps via ssl.bing.com/webmaster. Activated when you connect Bing in Settings. Privacy Statement · Services Agreement

IndexNow — Notifies Bing, Yandex, and Cloudflare via api.indexnow.org when a URL is published or updated. Activated only if Instant Indexing auto-submit is turned on in Settings. Privacy Policy · Terms

AdWorks.Bid OAuth Broker — Exchanges Google OAuth authorization codes for access tokens via oauth.adworksbid.com so your client secret never touches the browser. Activated when you connect GSC or GA4; only your site URL, a temporary code, and a nonce are sent — no post content or user data. Privacy Policy · Terms

Google Fonts (Cairo) — Loads a typeface for the admin interface via fonts.googleapis.com on every CitedSEO admin page. Privacy Policy · Fonts FAQ

دعم اللغة العربية (Arabic Language Support)

سيتد إس إي أو (CitedSEO) هو إضافة ووردبريس مجانية لتحسين محركات البحث، مصممة لعصر البحث بالذكاء الاصطناعي. توفر الإضافة تحليلاً للصفحات، بيانات منظمة (Schema)، خرائط مواقع XML، تتبع ترتيب الكلمات المفتاحية، وتكاملاً مع Google Search Console وGoogle Analytics 4 — كل ذلك مجانًا بالكامل. تدعم الإضافة اللغة العربية بشكل كامل: واجهة إدارة بتصميم من اليمين إلى اليسار (RTL)، تحليل محتوى يراعي خصائص اللغة العربية، وأداة لتوليد كلمات مفتاحية بلهجات عربية مختلفة (خليجية، مصرية، لبنانية، وغيرها). الإضافة مثالية لمواقع الشرق الأوسط ودول الخليج العربي التي تستهدف الظهور في نتائج البحث التقليدية ومحركات الذكاء الاصطناعي على حد سواء.
